title.narrative: EU4Business: Network of Business Support Centres in Ukraine

description.narrative: The Action contributes to stimulate the economy by strengthening the quality and supply of local business advisory services. It enhances the competitiveness of SMEs through increasing entrepreneurial skills, financial literacy, better understanding and ability to adjust to potential new markets within and outside Ukraine and utilise opportunities for innovation, and energy efficiency. It transfers industry-specific know-how to SMEs and improve access to finance.
